login.title: Sign in
login.text: This miner belongs to another user account on this computer, or local access without a token is turned off. Enter its access token.
login.token_hint: 64 characters (0–9, a–f), in ~/.config/spark-pearl-miner/api-token of the miner's user.
login.cmd_hint: Or, on the Spark as the miner's user, run one of these (the first opens this page already signed in):
login.err.bad_token: This token is not accepted. Copy it again from the api-token file.
login.err.network: Cannot reach the miner. Is the service running? Run: spark-pearl-miner status
login.expired: Your session ended (the miner restarted?). Sign in again.
wizard.welcome.title: Welcome
wizard.welcome.pitch: Turn your idle DGX Spark into Pearl (PRL) income at about 67 W on the GPU. Everything is already tuned for the Spark: you only need your wallet address.
wizard.welcome.stop: You can stop mining at any time from the dashboard.
wizard.presets.title: What is preconfigured for your Spark
wizard.presets.pools: Pools: Kryptex → HeroMiners BR → LuckyPool BR, with automatic failover (switch in about 1 s, return after 60 s stable)
wizard.presets.power: Power: Balanced profile, SM clock capped at 2000 MHz, stops above 85 W (measured about 67 W, GPU up to 80 °C)
wizard.presets.power_nocap: Power: Balanced profile, stops above 85 W; SM clock capped at 2000 MHz once the boot clock cap is installed (the installer offers it; measured about 67 W, GPU up to 80 °C)
wizard.presets.gpu: GPU use: exclusive while mining; pauses if free memory drops below 16 GiB
wizard.presets.later: Change wallet, worker name, language and pools later with the gear icon; everything else is in ~/.config/spark-pearl-miner/config.toml
wallet.title: Your wallet
wallet.intro: The pools pay your earnings to this Pearl address.
wallet.label: Pearl wallet address
wallet.ends: Compare both ends with your wallet app
wallet.hint: Use a wallet you control (self-custody). Exchange deposit addresses can change or refuse mining payouts.
wallet.fee_wallet: This is the developer's fee wallet: the fee switches itself off when you mine to it.
wallet.err.mixed_case: The address mixes upper and lower case. Copy it again from your wallet.
wallet.err.too_long: This is longer than a Pearl address. Copy only the address.
wallet.err.format: This does not look like a Pearl address: it must start with prl1p
wallet.err.charset: It contains a character that Pearl addresses never use (b, i, o, or a symbol). Copy the address again.
wallet.err.checksum: One or more characters are wrong (the checksum does not match). Copy the address again from your wallet.
wallet.err.hrp: This is an address of another coin: a Pearl address starts with prl1p
wallet.err.version: Only prl1p… addresses are supported (this is another address type).
wallet.err.length: The address has the wrong length. Copy the whole address again.
fee.title: Developer fee and start
fee.disclosure.1: About 2 % of mining time works for the developer's fixed wallet, in short slices, only while you mine.
fee.disclosure.2: It is built into the program and cannot be changed or turned off.
fee.disclosure.3: The dashboard shows it when it happens.
fee.accept: I understand and accept the 2 % developer fee
